propositions: _fold_heads currently merges bundle heads into the worktree HEAD, making the heal result dependent on the checked-out branch
_require_tracker_on_ref refuses heals when current_branch != ref, preventing healing of trackers on side branches or detached HEAD
The fold must be rewritten to merge into refs/heads/<ref> directly using git merge-tree and git commit-tree, independent of worktree state
Publishing the folded result must use git update-ref for unchecked-out refs and git reset --hard for checked-out refs to maintain index/worktree consistency
The merge=ours driver policy for .bridge_state/* files must be preserved when replacing git merge with git merge-tree
A narrow dirty-worktree refusal should replace the blanket refusal guard, allowing off-branch and detached-HEAD heals to succeed
